referencePolicy.allowed: Broad visual-language study only: grounded industrial function and damage, strategic-scale silhouette readability, compact objective/cover/breach logic, and biome/faction/infestation separation.
referencePolicy.forbidden: Copying, tracing, extracting, recreating, or treating any reference-game asset, layout, silhouette, texture, decal, logo, icon, faction mark, palette, effect, organism, screenshot, or named landmark as MASSFRONT source art or provenance.

sets.unitOfAuthoring: one site per Spline document or intentionally isolated scene root
one preset prompt block per Spline document; never paste an entire planet file at once
one district per Spline document or intentionally isolated scene root
one orbital prompt or one named location prompt per selected Spline document; never paste all nine blocks together

requiredAuthoringSequence: connect a selected Spline 3D document and enable its AI bridge
load the Spline authoring guide before the first MCP run_code call
paste or execute one prompt only
inspect the scene tree and measured geometry before visual review
correct geometry, materials, routes, pivots, UVs, collisions and LODs
capture matched top-down, tactical-oblique, close and required phone-cutaway views
export source and candidate GLB with provenance and hashes
keep runtimeReady false until packaged-runtime and device evidence pass
